The command-palette fixture is CAPABILITY-ONLY (zero strict scenarios): the two wrappers' pre-JS-hook SSR shells are irreconcilable by design (svelte emits a bare root; keen stamps a driver id + data-mode/data-display/data-locked-length SSR-state attrs), so there is no shared golden — correctness is carried by this map (axis-2) + the fixture's cssStateClasses / cssStateElements / deferred inventory. Only the two shared, SSR-structural features are modeled: `size` (the one block modifier svelte SSR-emits, via `size` → pa-command-palette--{size}) and `display` (svelte `displayStyle`; structural, no class). `show` is NOT mapped (it toggles the --active state class at runtime, a cssStateClass); fullscreen, mode, and all the runtime-state inputs (commands/contexts/results/activeIndex/loading/…) are svelte-internal $state or data lists, not oracle features. See modal.map.json / settings-panel.json for the model.
